feature.name: Text (WordArt) styles
feature.what_it_does: Apply WordArt-style fill, outline and effects to the text inside a selected drawing object.
feature.affects: the decorative styling of text inside the selected object
feature.behavior: Apply WordArt-style fill, outline and effects to the text inside a selected drawing object.
